name: Dock Comet
tagline: The command deck for the modern marina.
positioning: Dock Comet unifies slip assignments, dockage billing, and dockmaster operations into one luminous platform — so independent marinas run like flagship harbors.

hero.h1: Run your marina like it's the future of the waterfront.
hero.sub: Dock Comet retires the dry-erase board, the tangled spreadsheet, and the shoebox of paper contracts — replacing them with one radiant system for slips, billing, and boaters.

features.title: Living slip map
features.description: Drag every vessel onto a real-time harbor map. Reassign slips, track LOA and beam, and see open water before the phone even rings.

features.title: Dockage bills itself
features.description: Recurring slip fees, metered electric, and seasonal contracts invoice on autopilot. Overdue boaters get nudged automatically — you just get paid.

features.title: Waitlist that works the phones
features.description: Turn your slip waitlist into a revenue engine. When a berth opens, Dock Comet offers it down the line and closes the deal by text.

features.title: Transient reservations
features.description: Let passing captains book an overnight slip online with the exact dimensions that fit. Deposits, gate codes, and dock maps go out instantly.

features.title: The document vault
features.description: Insurance certificates, vessel registrations, and signed contracts live in one place, and Dock Comet flags every expiration before it bites.

features.title: Occupancy you can steer by
features.description: Watch dockage revenue, seasonal turnover, and berth utilization update live — the numbers a dockmaster used to guess at, now on the bridge.

testimonials.quote: We onboarded 214 slips in a weekend and killed the whiteboard for good. My dockhands finally know which vessel goes where without radioing me twice an hour.
testimonials.name: Marcus Alderton

testimonials.quote: Dockage used to be a shoebox and a prayer every April. Dock Comet invoices the whole season automatically — collections are up nineteen percent and I stopped chasing checks.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

testimonials.quote: The transient booking flow pays for itself. Weekenders reserve the right-sized slip online, prepay, and roll in with a gate code. My dock feels ten years ahead.
testimonials.name: Dale Krupinski

pricing.blurb: For the solo owner-operator finally ditching the dry-erase board.
For growing marinas running a real dock crew and a real waitlist.
For multi-location harbor groups steering a whole fleet of marinas.

homepage.footerBlurb: Dock Comet is the command deck for independent marinas — slips, dockage, and boaters in one luminous system built for owner-operators.
